title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 彼がアルバイトを<u>首</u>になった<u>要因</u>は、ＳＮＳに店内や客の写真を<u>むやみに</u>投稿していたことだ。ＳＮＳに何でもアップすると、デジタルタトゥーとなり、後で<u>ろくな</u>ことにならない。
english_translation: The reason for his dismissal from his part-time job was that he was recklessly posting pictures of the store and customers on social media. Posting anything on social media is like a digital tattoo; it won't be good for you later on.
